card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of longer words that are split into parts, such as 'Mic' or 'rop' in microparticle, 'Co' in Coeur, 'CAP' in CAPLYTA, and 'ml' in amlodipine. The pole fires before the rest of the word is completed.

modes.label: Split technical words
modes.description: Early pieces of long scientific words such as microparticle or microspheres.

modes.label: Split names
modes.description: Early pieces of drug or foreign names that are cut into parts.
